# Claudeter

> Claudeter is an AI agency and product studio that builds voice agents, AI automation, healthcare RCM automation and AI-first software for companies in the USA, UAE and India. Typical delivery is about six weeks, starting with a three-day discovery sprint that ships a proof of concept. Clients receive full IP transfer with no lock-in.

## Site
- [Homepage](https://www.claudeter.ai/): services, process, industries, stack, about, client stories, contact
- [Blog](https://www.claudeter.ai/blog/): articles on AI voice agents, RCM automation, UAE healthcare (DHA eClaims, TPA portals) and AI across industries
- [RSS](https://www.claudeter.ai/blog/feed.xml)

## Articles
- [How Much Does an AI Voice Agent Cost in 2026?](https://www.claudeter.ai/blog/ai-voice-agent-cost-2026/): Per-minute rates hide most of the cost. Here is how to model build cost, run cost and the fees vendors leave off the pricing page.

Clinical triage is not. Here is the line, and how to build the phone agent on the right side of it.

The hard part is the 271 response that answers half the question.
- [Denial Management Automation: How AI Cuts Rework and Recovers Revenue](https://www.claudeter.ai/blog/denial-management-automation-ai/): Most denied claims are never appealed, yet most appeals win. Here is how automation works both ends of that gap.

- [Arabic-English AI Voice Agents for UAE Businesses: Dialects, PDPL and What Actually Works](https://www.claudeter.ai/blog/ai-voice-agents-uae-arabic-english/): UAE callers switch between Arabic and English mid-sentence and expect both handled.
